title: What Should Have Been Done (kellett volna)
grammar: Deontic hindsight: kellett volna + infinitive and nem szabadott volna + infinitive
goal: I can express unfulfilled past obligations using kellett volna + infinitive.
I can express past prohibitions that were violated using nem szabadott volna + infinitive.
I can use dative subjects (-nak/-nek) with inflected infinitives for personal accountability.

sections.title: Unit 8: Medicine, Ethics & Responsibility
body: Evaluating medical decisions, moral dilemmas, and historical responsibility requires looking back at past turning points and asking what should have been done, what could have been prevented, and what someone ought to have foreseen.

Hungarian constructs past modality by combining a past-tense modal verb or suffix with the invariant particle 'volna': 'szólnia kellett volna' (he should have spoken up), 'megelőzhették volna' (they could have prevented it), 'tudhatta volna' (she could/should have known). Through physician-writer László Németh's psychological novel Iszony (1947), you will explore conscience, caregiving, and the ethical weight of irrevocable choices.
